chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from Abi 'Abdillah (عليه السلام), who said:

When Abu Talib passed away, Jibra'il descended upon Rasul Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) and said: “O Muhammad, leave Makkah, for you have no supporter in it.” Quraysh rose against the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله), so he went out fleeing until he came to a mountain in Makkah called al-Hajun, and he made his way to it.

key_terms.تُوُفِّيَ: passed away; referring here to the death of Abu Talib
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibra'il, the angel who conveyed the divine message
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, referring to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.قُرَيْشٌ: the Quraysh tribe of Makkah who opposed the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.هَارِبًا: fleeing or escaping due to danger

ai.seo_question: What happened after the death of Abu Talib, and how did it affect the Prophet's safety in Makkah?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts that after the death of Abu Talib, Jibra'il informed Rasul Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) that he no longer had a protector in Makkah. It describes the intensification of Quraysh's hostility and the Prophet's departure in fear to al-Hajun, highlighting Abu Talib's crucial protective role.

en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Nasr, from Ibrahim Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When Abu Talib<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> passed away, Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> descended unto Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and he<sup>as</sup> said: ‘O Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>! Exit from Makkah, for there isn’t a helper for you<sup>saww</sup> therein, and the Qureysh arose against the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, so he<sup>saww</sup> went out fleeing until he<sup>saww</sup> came to a mountain of Makkah called Al-Hajoun, so he<sup>saww</sup> came to it’.
en.sarwar: 31. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu Nasr from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Ash‘ari from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurara from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.

“When abu Talib (a.s.) passed away, Jibril came to the Messenger of Allah and said, “O Muhammad, migrate from Makka. There is no one to help you. Qurash revolted against the Holy Prophet (s.a) and came out of Makka running away until he reach one of the mountains of Makka. Called al-Hajun. He went there.”
